description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables for the backend API, specifically for handling Supabase credentials. It includes a Pydantic model for validation, a cached function to load the environment variables, and documentation.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Pydantic model representing configuration settings loaded from environment variables, includes fields for Supabase URL and anonymous key.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads environment variables SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, validates their presence, and returns a Settings instance. Uses caching to avoid reloading.

ctags.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
ctags.pattern: /^    SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: str = Field(..., description="Supabase anon key")$/

ctags.name: SUPABASE_URL
ctags.pattern: /^    SUPABASE_URL: str = Field(..., description="Supabase project URL")$/
